task_title: merge-train: fix rollback/status recovery gaps before live enable cutover (issue #1151)

plan_review.notes: Adversarial review (gpt-5.4, high reasoning) red-teamed DEC-019/020/021 with 3 alternatives (separate machine-verification from printStatus; centralize hydrated-lookup helper; canonicalize vs shape-preserve on rollback) and 6 concerns. All 6 resolved: (1) [Blocking] findRulesetByName silently picked first match on duplicate-named rulesets -- fixed to throw AmbiguousRulesetNameError, propagated + tested at status/enable/rollback. (2) postcondition-vs-printStatus coupling -- deferred, only one hydrate-then-validate call site exists today, no duplication to centralize yet; documented as DEC-022. (3) hydration race on getRuleset(id) -- verified already fail-closed (no 404 catch, unlike getClassicProtection/getMergeTrainEnabled), no code change needed. (4) rollback preserves drifted bypass actor -- fixed: added explicit WARNING log on actor-id mismatch vs supplied --app-id, without normalizing (keeps disable non-policy-making). (5) classic.missing tri-state suggestion -- deferred, existing pure-function contract predates this fix, churn not justified for a naming/readability change with no behavior delta. (6) duplicate-ruleset test coverage -- added (1 unit + 3 orchestration tests). See ADR 0062 DEC-022 for full per-concern writeup.

rounds.notes: 2 non-blocking suggestions: (a) hydration-fetch race in printStatus accepted as intentional fail-closed (ADR DEC-022 pt3), no change; (b) missing negative test for rollback drift-warning gate -- fixed by adding new test.
Re-reviewed full diff plus new negative test; confirmed test is load-bearing (brackets both sides of the appId&&liveBypassId&&mismatch gate). No new issues. Verdict: clean, no remaining concerns.

gpt-5.4: no significant issues found. gemini-3.1-pro-preview: found 1 legitimate non-blocking gap -- rollback's drift-warning gate (added in plan-review fix #4) only detected drift via inferTrainAppId(), which strictly filters for actor_type==='Integration', so a live bypass actor tampered into a non-Integration type (e.g. RepositoryRole) would silently escape the warning even though buildRulesetDisablePayload still preserves it verbatim. Adjudicated (claude-sonnet-5) as valid and fixed: gate now checks hasLiveActors (any bypass_actors entry present) instead of liveBypassId truthiness. Added test covering the non-Integration-actor case. Re-ran full suite: 53/53 passing after fix. ADR 0062 DEC-023 records this finding and fix.
